inference.cluster_policy: Resample all seven nested-p observations for one fresh seed as a complete trajectory, independently within L=11 and L=13. Analyze this 20-cluster cohort independently from every earlier wave.
inference.crossing_policy: Retain no-crossing and multiple-crossing outcomes. Quote a conditional central 90% interval only together with its topology support.
inference.cell_sign_policy: Classify the L11/L13 LER difference only when its central 90% seed-trajectory bootstrap interval excludes zero.
inference.selection_rationale: The matched L11 cap diagnostic shows that raising the cap changes convergence flags without changing logical outcomes. The same seven-point high-p grid and 20 fresh clusters now isolate whether the unresolved L9/L11 topology persists, disappears, or reverses at the next size pair under the unchanged primary decoder.
inference.promotion_gate: This wave may update only the L11/L13 finite-size topology at q=0.85,0.90,0.95. Do not promote p_c(q), q_c, add q=0.925, or start square unless the registered 90% topology/sign gates are satisfied and reconciled with the L9/L11 evidence.

provenance_policy: Every shard must use one identical runtime/source cohort and pass raw-count, gzip/SHA-256, syndrome-fidelity, configuration, and start/end source-stability checks. Fresh seed clusters and raw observations are never pooled with earlier cohorts.
execution_gate: Passed 26/26 runner, dispatcher, analyzer, recovery, cap-diagnostic, and scaling-manifest tests plus a three-job dry run on 2026-08-28. Production may start; every shard remains fail-closed on syndrome fidelity and source stability.
purpose: Smallest correction-to-scaling matrix that directly tests the unresolved high-q L9/L11 behavior at the next adjacent size pair without changing the decoder, adding a q midpoint, or expanding to square.
